reason: A curated MCP server bundle that extends DeepSeek Harness with agent-accessible tools for filesystem operations, browser automation, GitHub integration, memory graphs, demo utilities, and remote HTTP servers.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 集成一组可配置的 MCP 服务器，提供文件操作、浏览器自动化、GitHub、记忆图谱及远程 HTTP 工具。
summaries.en: Integrates a configurable bundle of MCP servers with DeepSeek Harness for filesystem operations, browser automation, GitHub access, memory graphs, and remote HTTP tools.

capabilities: Connects DeepSeek Harness to configured MCP servers over stdio or streamable HTTP
Can invoke filesystem read, write, and search tools within configured roots
Can expose browser navigation, clicking, and screenshots through Playwright
Can access GitHub repositories, issues, and pull requests when configured with a token
Can connect to remote HTTP MCP endpoints with optional authentication headers
Can maintain an in-session entity and relation knowledge graph
